verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the `--period` option, which records a separate run for each period of a recurring process. That is bookkeeping for recurring work, not a scheduler that triggers jobs. Ultrametric runs no model, and nothing shows it can start workflows on a timer or cron. missing for 10: an actual scheduling or trigger mechanism (cron/interval/calendar), automatic execution of recurring runs, documentation of schedule management, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
